# METIS

> METIS (metisai.in) is an AI product studio and consultancy in India. We help teams work out where AI pays off, then design, build and ship it - AI strategy and validation, AI agents, workflow automations, enterprise AI and AI product engineering - and teach them to run it. Operating since November 2023, with 25+ clients. Contact: info@metisai.in.

METIS works across five capabilities: AI Strategy & Validation, Enterprise AI, Agentic Systems, Workflow Automations, and Product Engineering. Engagements start with a fixed-fee Discovery Sprint or scoped pilot; builds run as fixed-cost projects or embedded teams. The Notes section covers building AI products in India, including the DPDP Act and sector rules that affect them.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://metisai.in/): What METIS does, the five capabilities, how engagements start, and a short FAQ.
- [Services](https://metisai.in/services/): The five capabilities and the services under each.
- [Services in detail](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/): Every service METIS builds, listed per capability.
- [About](https://metisai.in/about/): Who METIS is and how we work.
- [Contact](https://metisai.in/contact/): Send a few lines about the problem; we scope the riskiest part first.

## Capabilities

- [Enterprise AI](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/#enterprise-ai): Production applications with compliance and security designed in from day one.
- [Agentic Systems](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/#agentic-systems): Autonomous agents that reason, decide and act across existing tools.
- [Workflow Automations](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/#workflow-automations): End-to-end automation of manual, multi-step processes.
- [AI Strategy & Validation](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/#ai-strategy-validation): Validate the riskiest idea first with a working proof of concept.
- [Product Engineering](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/#product-engineering): Native-quality apps and products with AI at the core, built end to end.

## Notes

- [Notes index](https://metisai.in/blog/): Practical writing on building AI products in India: DPDP, customer data, regulation and production.
- [Send Indian customer data to OpenAI or Claude?](https://metisai.in/blog/dpdp-sending-customer-data-to-ai-models/): India's DPDP framework permits cross-border transfer unless a country is restricted, and what that means for teams building AI products.
- [140 or 1600: which series must insurance calls use?](https://metisai.in/blog/trai-140-1600-series-insurance-calls/): TRAI's 1600-series deadline for insurers (15 February 2026), the 140 series for promotional calls, and which series applies to renewals.
